subrules.name: 702.217a
subrules.rule: Solidarity is a triggered ability. “Solidarity” means “Whenever you attack and there are six or more different creature types among attacking creatures, if this is the first solidarity ability you control that has resolved this turn, create a Solidarity token.” See rule 111.10aa.

mechanics.original_reminder: Whenever you attack with six or more different creature types, create a Solidarity enchantment with “Attacking creatures you control get +1/+0” if you haven't this turn.
mechanics.executable_reminder: Whenever you attack and there are six or more different creature types among attacking creatures, resolve the first solidarity ability you control this turn as follows: Create a Solidarity token.

semantic_equivalence.evidence: All fifteen operational sources extracted by exact primary corpus key, preserving both faces where present. Frontend and runtime proof pending; inventory is not support certification.
